records.subject: Optimized carbon-paste-electrode potentiometric sensor
records.quote: Under the optimum percentage of CPE composite, the sensor displayed linearity in the range of 4.8 x 10(-7)-1.0 x 10(-2) M, a slope of 19.17 +/- 0.57 mV decade(-1), a limit of detection of 1.45 x 10(-7) M, a response time of 5 s, and a lifetime of 9 weeks to measure Bi(III) ions.

records.subject: Optimized carbon-paste-electrode potentiometric sensor
records.quote: The application of the sensor to determine Bi(III) ions was evaluated by analyzing several real samples such as well water samples, river water samples, and pharmacological products.
context_quotes: The relative recoveries for the real samples were in the range of 93.8-98.1% with a relative standard deviation between 0.71 and 1.98%, indicating that the sensor has an excellent ability to the routine measurement of Bi(III) ion in the pharmacological and water samples with a suitable linear range and fast response time.
